blocks.text: BTS’ Jungkook has added another notch to his TikTok record, with six of his songs each surpassing 3 million uses on the platform. Jungkook’s most-used song on TikTok was “Left and Right,” his collaboration with the American singer-songwriter Charlie Puth. The song has been used in more than 23.2 million posts. “Dreamers” followed with 16.9 million posts, while “Seven” surpassed 8.5 million. “Left and Right (Sped Up Ver.)” was used in over 3.9 million posts, “3D” in 3.2 million and “Still With You” in around 3 million.
